root_interface.arguments: --output <new absolute canonical nonsymlink directory> --run-id <32 lowercase hex characters>
root_interface.source_root: Derived from the frozen probe location, two parents above scripts/isaac. Preserve listed project modules and the runtime API reference file in that source tree.
root_interface.host_containment: Existing Windows Job containment required; root runs only after026 closes. No execution was started here.
root_interface.outputs: result.json, fixture.json, probe-source.py and original numeric arrays in arrays/*.npz with file/raw-byte digests.
root_interface.result_scope: passed_range_change_fixture means both cadence phases met this small geometric oracle. It does not accept host closure, full-factory cadence integration or transport.

fixture: One static lidar and one collision cube wall, no robot/ROS/asset references or render products. World is initialized/reset before the original sensor is created using exactly dict(LIDAR_PARAMETERS), including enable_semantics=True and720x1 profile.

Both phases share the same World, original lidar and interface. After60 baseline warmup steps, each phase runs6 blocks of6 actual physics steps with wall x centers6,4,7,6,4,7m; wall size0.2x4x2m and lidar at0,0,1m.

Baseline uses app.update with actual one-frame/dt checks. Candidate uses the existing Local45Stepper(render_every_steps=6), including its check that render-only refresh does not advance physics. Configured physics/rendering dt remains1/60; only render invocation cadence changes.

Each block preserves original linear/uint16 depth, intensity, azimuth and zenith arrays and their shapes/dtypes/digests before range rejection. World counters are recorded before/after reads, never substituted by loop counters or sensor timestamps.

The closest actual forward azimuth ray must hit the wall front at (wall_x-0.1)/(cos(actual_azimuth)*cos(actual_zenith)). Horizontal geometry and the selected beam's wall intersection are checked. A changed wall must change both the forward range and native depth digest; stale repeated ranges fail.

Oracle tolerance is an authored design budget: four uint16 depth quanta across the configured min/max range, half-bin projection at0.25degrees, plus0.0001m floating margin. The actual uint16 dtype is required before using this budget; it is not measured factory accuracy.

Per-phase actual steps/time, total wall duration including evidence IO, and stepping-only wall duration are separate. Any displayed baseline/candidate ratio is fixture-only, not measured whole-factory speed.
failure_and_cleanup: Initial and partial phase evidence are checkpointed. Primary failure/result is saved before native teardown; finally attempts app.close even if final metadata save fails. sdk_close_requested/returned and cleanup_errors remain separate from required host Job closure. No existing runtime, facade or stepper source was changed.

validation.kind: one cold SDK Python3.10 AST pass
validation.scope: Read/parse probe bytes and hash dependencies only; no product or SDK imports. No CPU suite or previous tests were run.

limits: Actual SDK API execution, dynamic range response, reduced-render behavior and performance are unverified until root's one frozen probe.

Native absolute acquisition timestamp remains unavailable. World read time is observation context only; current-frame native acquisition timestamp is explicitly not verified, even if six-step geometry response passes.
No GT steering, fabricated ranges, altered timestamps, motion/TTL/start-gate changes, fleet cadence switch, SDK/GPU/ROS/WSL/bag/Git operations, dependencies or agents.
Active026 immutable source, processes and originals were not accessed or modified. Root owns review, execution and any later integration decision.
